params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repoPath = Join-Path $HOME 'HeavenBridgeRepo'; $credText = ("protocol=https`nhost=github.com`n`n" | git -C $repoPath credential fill | Out-String); $user = (($credText -split "`n") | Where-Object { $_ -like 'username=*' } | Select-Object -First 1) -replace '^username=',''; $token = (($credText -split "`n") | Where-Object { $_ -like 'password=*' } | Select-Object -First 1) -replace '^password=',''; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($token)) { throw 'Git credential helper did not return a GitHub credential.' }; $headers = @{ Authorization = ('Bearer ' + $token); Accept='application/vnd.github+json'; 'X-GitHub-Api-Version'='2022-11-28'; 'User-Agent'='mhw-heaven-bridge' }; $dispatchUri = 'https://api.github.com/repos/fengie/mhw-mods/actions/workflows/updater-installed-client-e2e.yml/dispatches'; $body = @{ ref='main' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri $dispatchUri -Headers $headers -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $runsUri = 'https://api.github.com/repos/fengie/mhw-mods/actions/workflows/updater-installed-client-e2e.yml/runs?event=workflow_dispatch&per_page=5'; $runs = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Get -Uri $runsUri -Headers $headers; $runs.workflow_runs | Select-Object -First 5 id,status,conclusion,head_sha,event,created_at,html_url | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 -Compress
